confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for San Antonio cost-of-living aggregates (Numbeo-derived figures via Expatica, Livingcost and similar). Those aggregates gave meal, coffee and beer prices. Beer was stated for a 0.5 L serving, so I adjusted it slightly for a typical US pint. No direct San Antonio cocktail or restaurant wine-by-the-glass price was found. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local relationship to beer, at roughly 2x and 2.4x. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings, and are the least certain. Pricing is for July 2026. The RBA rate is the latest observation found, dated 18 November 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on San Antonio aggregate price data. Accommodation is benchmarked against mid-priced Texas cities such as Austin and Houston, with San Antonio's Riverwalk tourism demand in mind, but at lower rates than Austin.
